about: A small self-hosted server that turns a folder of ebooks into a library that reading apps can browse.

prs.title: Folders with # in their names can be paged
prs.broken: In folders named like "C# Programming", the next page and parent links broke at the "#", so books past the first page could not be reached.
prs.changed: These links now encode the folder name properly.
prs.matters: Large folders with # in their names can be browsed to the end.

prs.title: Books with % in their names open
prs.broken: A book or folder with a percent sign in its name could not be opened. The server gave an error, or served a different file.
prs.changed: The server no longer decodes the address a second time.
prs.matters: Every book in the folder can be downloaded, whatever its name.
